# `ptfkit.wosten2001`

```cpp
import ptfkit.wosten2001;
```

**Exported namespace:** `ptfkit::wosten2001`

Wösten et al. (2001), Staring Series hydraulic parameters for Dutch soils.

## Source

Wösten, J. H. M., Veerman, G. J., de Groot, W. J. M., & Stolte, J. (2001). Waterretentie- en doorlatendheidskarakteristieken van boven- en ondergronden in Nederland: de Staringreeks; vernieuwde uitgave 2001. Alterra-rapport 153. Wageningen: Alterra.

## Scope

**Territory:** Netherlands

**Dataset:** 832 measured soil-horizon hydraulic characteristics used to define 18 topsoil and 18 subsoil classes and to fit continuous regressions for mineral soils.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/wosten2001.md)

```cpp
};
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | Residual volumetric water content. (cm³/cm³) |
| `theta_s` | Saturated volumetric water content. (cm³/cm³) |
| `saturated_conductivity` | Saturated hydraulic conductivity. (cm/day) |
| `alpha` | Inverse pressure-head scale of the van Genuchten model. (1/cm) |
| `conductivity_shape_parameter` | Mualem hydraulic-conductivity shape parameter. (dimensionless) |
| `n` | van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. (dimensionless) |

## `Wosten2001Table5Parameters`

```cpp
struct Wosten2001Table5Parameters {
    double bulk_density;
    double theta_s;
    double saturated_conductivity;
    double alpha;
    double conductivity_shape_parameter;
    double n;
};
```

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bulk_density` | Dry bulk density predicted through the printed reciprocal-density regression. (g/cm³) |
| `theta_s` | Saturated volumetric water content predicted by the continuous regression. (cm³/cm³) |
| `saturated_conductivity` | Back-transformed saturated hydraulic conductivity. (cm/day) |
| `alpha` | Back-transformed van Genuchten inverse pressure-head scale. (1/cm) |
| `conductivity_shape_parameter` | Back-transformed Mualem hydraulic-conductivity shape parameter. (dimensionless) |
| `n` | Back-transformed van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. (dimensionless) |

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_wosten2001_class_parameters` {#function-calc_ptf_wosten2001_class_parameters}

Return the six published hydraulic parameters for a Staring Series class.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Wosten2001ClassParameters calc_ptf_wosten2001_class_parameters(Wosten2001SoilClass soil_class)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `soil_class` | Source class identifier used to select a Table 3 row. |

#### Returns

A `Wosten2001ClassParameters` value.

!!! note

    Class identifiers select published rows; this function does not classify soil from texture ranges.

!!! warning

    The source cautions that class means may not apply outside the measured ranges within each class.

### `calc_ptf_wosten2001_hydraulic` {#function-calc_ptf_wosten2001_hydraulic}

Evaluate water content and conductivity from Staring Series parameters.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Wosten2001HydraulicResult calc_ptf_wosten2001_hydraulic(double theta_r, double theta_s, double saturated_conductivity, double alpha, double conductivity_shape_parameter, double n, double pressure_head_magnitude)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `theta_r` | Residual volumetric water content. (cm³/cm³) |
| `theta_s` | Saturated volumetric water content. (cm³/cm³) |
| `saturated_conductivity` | Saturated hydraulic conductivity. (cm/day) |
| `alpha` | van Genuchten inverse pressure-head scale. (1/cm) |
| `conductivity_shape_parameter` | Mualem hydraulic-conductivity shape parameter. (dimensionless) |
| `n` | van Genuchten pore-size distribution parameter. (dimensionless) |
| `pressure_head_magnitude` | Nonnegative magnitude of pressure head; callers must convert any signed-negative convention explicitly before calling. (cm) |

#### Returns

A `Wosten2001HydraulicResult` value.

!!! note

    Pressure head is accepted as a nonnegative magnitude to make the sign convention explicit.

!!! warning

    Parameters must belong to one internally consistent van Genuchten-Mualem parameter set.

### `calc_ptf_wosten2001_sand_topsoil_table5` {#function-calc_ptf_wosten2001_sand_topsoil_table5}

Evaluate the printed Table 5 regressions for mineral sandy topsoils.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Wosten2001Table5Parameters calc_ptf_wosten2001_sand_topsoil_table5(double silt, double organic_matter, double median_sand_size)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `silt` | Mass percentage of particles smaller than 50 micrometers. (%) |
| `organic_matter` | Soil organic-matter mass percentage. (%) |
| `median_sand_size` | Median particle size of the sand fraction. (µm) |

#### Returns

A `Wosten2001Table5Parameters` value.

!!! note

    This function fixes the source-defined BOVENGROND indicator to 1.

!!! note

    Positive inputs are required by the reciprocal and natural-log terms.

!!! warning

    The reciprocal-density expression must be positive before inversion.

!!! warning

    These are the printed rounded Table 5 equations; they do not claim numerical parity with the unavailable Staringreeks 1.0 program.

!!! warning

    The report does not publish the legacy program's applicability-warning thresholds.
